review: run.py gives M = I/4 - J/16 with eigenvalues 1/16 along (1,1,1) and 1/4 twice plus the exact quartic term, finds by exhaustive search that exactly 48 integer maps with entries in {-1,0,1} leave u invariant (S_4 of the four predecessors times the inversion) and that they fix a single quadratic form up to scale, derives c = 4 sigma^2/pi from det M = 1/256, and shows by FFT at L = 64 and 128 that C sqrt(x^T M^-1 x) rises toward c as L doubles while matching the image-carrying reference to 1 % on the diagonals: the task's expectations hold.
what: WORKED COMPUTATION (independent run 2 of 2): The linear kernel of the 3+1 formation law, exactly. phi(k) = (1 + e^{ik1} + e^{ik2} + e^{ik3})/4, u = |phi|^2. (1) With sympy: 1 - u = k^T M k + O(k^4); give M, its eigenvalues and eigenvectors (expected: 1/16 along (1,1,1) and 1/4 twice), and the O(k^4) term. (2) Find the group of linear maps k -> A k (integer matrices) with u(Ak) = u(k) by exhaustive search over entries in {-1,0,1}; give its order and show that the metric M is, up to scale, the unique invariant quadratic form (so the kernel is isotropic in the level plane's natural geometry). (3) The equal-level covariance of the linear model is C(x) = sigma^2 (2 pi)^-3 Int e^{ik.x}/(1-u): derive its large-|x| form c/sqrt(x^T M^-1 x) with the exact constant c = sigma^2/(4 pi sqrt(det M)); (4) check it numerically: FFT at L = 64 and 128, table of C(x) sqrt(x^T M^-1 x) along three directions. Expectation: a plateau at c. DELIVERABLE in your unit worktree: probes/work/compute/linear-kernel-3plus1/<your worker name>/run.py (self-contained; exact arithmetic wherever the statement is exact; numpy only for the numerical cross-checks named) and RESULT.md (the table or formulas, in plain text). run.py prints one line per result, a final `SUMMARY: <the main result in one line>`, and `HIT: <what>` ONLY if a result contradicts the expectation stated in the task (that is the interesting case: report it precisely). Two workers do each computation independently; the supervisor compares them. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/compute/linear-kernel-3plus1/<name>/run.py"
